subject: Invoice delivery preferences & VAT handling for Redwood Pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightdata.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T09:14:00-04:00
Subject: Billing contact & invoice delivery for pilot

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. Finance has asked for clarity on how Redwood will deliver invoices for the pilot: our AP team prefers invoices emailed to ap@brightdata.com (PDF) and they require a PDF with our PO number on it. They also asked whether invoices can be uploaded to our supplier portal (we have a restricted SFTP/portal) instead of email. Our secondary question is VAT handling — BrightData is VAT-registered in Ireland (VAT IE1234567). Will Redwood invoice with VAT applied or do you support reverse-charge invoicing?

Could you confirm next steps and send a sample/pro forma invoice we can route to AP?

Best,
Liam
Billing Operations
BrightData
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightdata.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing contact & invoice delivery for pilot

Hi Liam — thanks, and great question. Short answers up front: we can do both PDF-by-email and portal delivery. For EU VAT we support invoicing with VAT applied or issuing a reverse-charge invoice if you provide a valid VAT ID.

A couple of details we need from you to proceed:
- Preferred delivery channel: 
  - Option A: PDF emailed to ap@brightdata.com (we'll copy your billing contact and include PO on the PDF)
  - Option B: Upload to your supplier portal / SFTP (we support SFTP drops and portal integrations; we will also send a notification email)
- Official billing contact name and email to appear on the invoice (AP email is fine, but we often include a billing contact name)
- The legal entity name and VAT number to use on the invoice for reverse-charge (you included IE1234567, can you confirm exact legal name?)
- PO number if you want it printed in the invoice header (otherwise we can include it in the body)

I'll attach a pro forma PDF and a short VAT questionnaire to help your tax team confirm reverse-charge eligibility. If you prefer email delivery, we'll send the invoice PDF to ap@brightdata.com and CC your billing contact. If portal/SFTP is required we can work with your team to exchange credentials or take a certified upload link.

Proposed next step: you confirm Option A or B and the legal entity text + PO, then I will route to finance and send the pro forma. Marcus (copied) will handle the portal/SFTP setup if needed.

Thanks — Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightdata.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: AP Team <ap@brightdata.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T17:28:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Billing contact & invoice delivery for pilot

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear options. Our AP team prefers Option A (PDF by email) because their vendor portal only accepts a small set of suppliers and onboarding would take ~2–3 weeks. For the pilot we need a quick email workflow.

Please use the following for the invoice:
- Legal entity: BrightData Ltd.
- VAT: IE1234567VH
- Billing contact: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@brightdata.com>
- PO: BD-2026-88

If reverse-charge is possible, please prepare the invoice accordingly; otherwise apply Irish VAT and we will provide the reverse-charge claim from our side. I'll let AP confirm acceptance once they see the pro forma.

Thanks,
Liam
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-19T08:05:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing contact & invoice delivery for pilot

Can Finance produce a pro forma PDF with BD-2026-88 printed in the header and check reverse-charge vs VAT applied? Also Marcus, can you confirm our PDF header will include our VAT number and a note about reverse-charge when applicable?

Attachments: VAT-Questionnaire.xlsx (filled by Liam)

Our deadlines: send pro forma before EOD 19 June so AP can route payment setup this week. Let me know if you need anything else.

— Neha
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-19T13:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing contact & invoice delivery for pilot

Neha — Finance created ProForma-Redwood-INV-1001.pdf and included a conditional VAT section. We set the invoice to reverse-charge (no VAT applied) because Liam provided a valid EU VAT number and legal name match. PDF will show: "Reverse charge: customer liable for VAT under Article 194" and include BrightData Ltd. VAT IE1234567VH and PO BD-2026-88.

We will email the final invoice PDF to ap@brightdata.com and CC oliver.hayes@brightdata.com. Marcus confirmed we can also push to SFTP later if they want onboarding — created a ticket: SUP-7210 for portal integration.

Attaching the pro forma now and marking the thread closed from finance side.

Laura Bennett
